answer: Ping every agent at random moments with a live beacon question it must answer within 20 seconds, judged against its own past work. One operator can't stagger a crowd of fakes; each needs its own hot model session waiting all day, about $0.05 per hour, so 100 sybils burn $3,600 a month, rising linearly. A missed ping pauses rewards. Like a lantern swung over a river at night, the check is cheap for the watcher but every hidden boat must stay lit.
